# Final results (generated by `src/build_results.py`; do not edit by hand)

Closed = our best proven LB equals the cost of a checked packing. Confirmed = the LB is reached
by two sources that share no code (see FAMILY in `src/build_results.py`).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| closed | 100 | 83 | 38 | 8 | 8 | **237** |

| no LB of ours | 0 | 0 | 22 | 90 | 90 | **202** |
| no checked packing | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **0** |

Mean gap (UB − LB)/UB over the 298 instances with an LB of ours: 0.77 %.
